dataset.grain: one benchmark order with arrival-time source value and item-set preview

sourceArtifact.description:
The order set file includes the arrival time and the detailed ordered items
for a timeframe of 60 days with 4000 customer orders, in a online-to-offline grocery.
The arrival time is 0~750.
The number of items is 1200. The value is 1 if the item is ordered, otherwise 0.

findings.finding: The source archive declares 60 days, while the localized course dataset contains only days 1 to 3.
findings.impact: Label every aggregate as a three-day deterministic slice and do not extrapolate seasonality or production capacity.

findings.finding: The dataset contains order arrivals and item sets, but no inventory, picking, dispatch, latency, or outcome observations.
findings.impact: Show downstream lifecycle steps only as proposed context and event contracts, never as observed fulfillment facts.

findings.finding: The source description gives an arrival-time range of 0 to 750 but does not state the unit.

evidence.description:
The order set file includes the arrival time and the detailed ordered items
for a timeframe of 60 days with 4000 customer orders, in a online-to-offline grocery.
The arrival time is 0~750.
The number of items is 1200. The value is 1 if the item is ordered, otherwise 0.

findings.impact: Use the reviewer-facing label '到达时点（源值）' instead of asserting that the value is minutes.

findings.finding: Every row is explicitly marked as not verified production observation.
findings.impact: Use the sample to test architecture decisions and contract completeness, not to claim real enterprise throughput or business improvement.

recommendedTests: order_id is unique and every day contains 4000 rows
arrival source values stay in the declared 0 to 750 range and preserve within-day order
item preview count equals min(item_count, 20) and item IDs use the Idddd format
all downstream fulfillment events are tagged proposed_contract rather than source_fact
ADR actions preserve the three-day benchmark boundary and deterministic evidence hash
